fields.statement: Rhiza notices conflicts before they bite: the daemon never restarts a change set it just shipped, rhiza check and the inbox warn when in-flight change sets overlap, and plan reviews check the plan against the other change sets in flight

fields.quote: if you run out of work keep picking high value tasks. don't stop and wait for my input.
fields.statement: Milestone 8 is three change sets picked by the orchestrator: the daemon skips just-shipped change sets, overlap warnings in check and the inbox, and plan review checking overlaps

The daemon skips an accepted change set whose latest run is a succeeded ship-change run that ended after the change set was last accepted or reopened; a succeeded plan or review run does not count, and a reopen makes it pickable again; the workflow name is passed into the daemon package, which does not import api
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: Overlap detection reuses model.Overlaps, extended to report an in-flight retire of a node another in-flight change set links to; rhiza check warns on overlaps under the in-flight rule, the inbox lists them as overlap items with no run, and decisions linked supersedes or relates-to across change sets are not treated as conflicts
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)

fields.statement: The plan reviewer runs rhiza overlaps for each plan change set, which counts the named draft as in flight, and records an overlap that contradicts the plan as a contradiction finding; no new finding kind is added
fields.wording: (assumed under the owner's standing instruction to decide on their behalf)
